definitions.explanation: A gathering of people to discuss matters, make decisions, or exchange information. Common in business and organizational settings.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{会議|かいぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わります→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time does the meeting end?

notes:
{会議|かいぎ} is a common business term for meeting or conference.

VERB USAGE:
- {会議|かいぎ}する: to hold a meeting
- {会議|かいぎ}を⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold/open a meeting
- {会議|かいぎ}に⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to attend a meeting
- {会議|かいぎ}に⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧する: to attend a meeting (formal)

TYPES OF MEETINGS:
- ⟦{定例|ていれい}→定例：noentry⟧{会議|かいぎ}: regular meeting
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{会議|かいぎ}: emergency meeting
- ⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧{会議|かいぎ}: board meeting
- ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧{会議|かいぎ}: online meeting
- ⟦ビデオ→ビデオ：01499_bideo⟧{会議|かいぎ}: video conference

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧: meeting room
- {会議|かいぎ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: in a meeting
- ⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧: agenda item
- ⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧: meeting minutes
